title: "Active pod" after EROS pod error prevents starting new pod
symptom: After deactivating and removing an Omnipod EROS pod, AAPS shows 'pod-activation in progress' and a pop-up message saying no pod is active. It is not possible to discard this non-existent pod activation, and no new pod can be activated. The system assumes a pod is connected and in initialization, and attempts to activate a pod abort before cannula setting. This makes the app unusable, and the only workaround is loading an old setup file.
evidence_quote: It's not possible to discard this (not existing) pod-activation. No new pod can be acitvated, the systems assumes there is a pod connected which is in the initalization process.
